fullPassage: Role-playing is an extension of representational skills. Children role-play when they use not only materials and objects but also voice and actions to represent others during play. Infants and toddlers begin to play a role when they imitate adults' language, dress, or actions. An older child expands on this role by imitating familiar roles, such as a parent or doctor. The child uses gestures and language to communicate his understanding of what this role represents. He uses the doctor kit or kitchen playthings as props to support his actions while he plays. For instance, he may use a cylinder-shaped block as a syringe when pretending to be a doctor. As he becomes familiar with other people and their roles, he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter. Playing fantasy characters, such as a monster or a superhero, becomes common once a child is able to engage in more abstract thinking.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

→ 본문: 'use not only materials and objects but also voice and actions to represent others'

③ to communicate (원문 그대로)
→ 본문: 'uses gestures and language to communicate his understanding'
→ 목적의 to부정사. 어법 정상.

→ 본문: 'when pretending to be a doctor'

det.analysis:
① as a means of communication (의사소통 수단으로)
→ 몸짓과 언어는 5번째 문장에서 의사소통에 쓰이지만, 이 빈칸은 doctor kit/kitchen playthings의 용도를 묻는 것.

→ 의사 도구나 주방 놀잇감을 자신의 행동을 뒷받침하는 소품으로 사용한다는 문맥.

③ as materials for abstract thinking (추상적 사고를 위한 재료로)
→ 추상적 사고는 마지막 문장의 환상 캐릭터 단계. 이 빈칸의 문맥과 무관.

questions.passage: Role-playing is an extension of representational skills. Children role-play when they use not only materials and objects but also voice and actions to represent others during play. Infants and toddlers begin to play a role when they imitate adults' language, dress, or actions. An older child __________, such as a parent or doctor. The child uses gestures and language to communicate his understanding of what this role represents. He uses the doctor kit or kitchen playthings as props to support his actions while he plays. For instance, he may use a cylinder-shaped block as a syringe when pretending to be a doctor. As he becomes familiar with other people and their roles, he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter. Playing fantasy characters, such as a monster or a superhero, becomes common once a child is able to engage in more abstract thinking.

다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오.
"나이가 든 아이는 익숙한 역할을 모방함으로써 이 역할을 __________."

det.analysis:
한국어: '이 역할을 확대한다'
→ 본문: 'An older child expands on this role by imitating familiar roles, such as a parent or doctor.'
→ 조건 단어: expands(1) + on(2) + this(3) + role(4) + by(5) + imitating(6) + familiar(7) + roles(8) = 8단어
→ 구문: expands on(확대하다, 구동사) + this role(목적어) + by imitating(수단) + familiar roles(동명사 목적어)
→ S-WORDCOUNT-MISMATCH: 조건 8단어 = wa 8단어 ✅
→ S-COND-WORD-MATCH: 모든 조건 단어가 wa에 포함 ✅
